text: Please provide an agronomically accurate text table is CSV text format, with columns (A), (B), (C)  The fertilizers' nutrition levels (A) be matched to the user's crop nutrition requirements (B), and that the nutrition levels of the fertilizers (A) be created in the recipes by proportions of plants on the bioaccumulator data using the nutrition information on the bioaccumulator list (C). So that when the bioaccumulator plants (C) are made into fertilizers via the recipes (A), the nutrition level of those fertilizer (A) match the nutritional needs of the user's crops (B).
